issues.description: Plan scope and DoD say 'All ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)'. InwardReportResponse has no model_config assignment. The two sibling row schemas (InwardConsolidationRow, InwardTransactionRow) both have it; InwardReportResponse does not.
issues.fix_instruction: Not required — intentional mirror of SalesReportResponse, which also omits from_attributes=True on the outer response class. InwardReportResponse is always constructed explicitly from Python lists in service code, never from an ORM object, so from_attributes=True is unnecessary. The plan's 'mirror SalesReportResponse pattern' instruction takes precedence over the loosely-worded 'All ConfigDict' phrase. Mark as pattern-consistent and closed.

notes: All three schemas export the exact field set specified in lld.json files[11] and the plan scope.
InwardConsolidationRow mirrors ConsolidationRow (sales_report.py) field-for-field, substituting no new columns.
InwardTransactionRow.place is typed str (not Optional, not enum) — correct DS-013 snapshot semantics.
No project imports; only datetime.date + pydantic.BaseModel + pydantic.ConfigDict.
Field names match all downstream consumers: InwardReportService (T-077), PdfExporter (T-085), ExcelExporter (T-086), inward_report.py router (T-080).
TC-195..TC-197 field access patterns (t.nos, c.total_nos, purchase_date, design_name) all satisfied by the implemented schema.
InwardReportResponse.model_config absence is pattern-consistent with SalesReportResponse — I-001 closed as ADR tradeoff.
